author: brandons209
description: Automated anti-bot / anti-raid moderation: cross-channel spam detection, suspicious-join and Discord spammer-badge handling, role-ping abuse lockdown, honeypot channels, and human-in-the-loop bot 'signature' learning. Configurable per-detector actions (ban/kick/timeout/role) with modlog reporting.
install_msg: Thanks for installing AntiBot! Set a notify channel with `[p]antibot notifychannel #channel` and review `[p]antibot settings`. Requires the Members and Message Content privileged intents.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild moderation configuration, per-member automated-action timestamps and counters, and learned bot 'signatures' consisting of hashes/fingerprints of avatar, message, and role features. No verbatim message content is retained.
